lyrics:
[Intro: soft piano, a room of people settling]

[Verse 1: male voice, gentle, like a toast]
The car's packed up and the tank is full
You've got your mother's eyes and my old tools
I had a speech, I lost the page
So here's what I've got, in the driveway

[Chorus: female voice joins, warm]
May the road know your name
May the door be unlocked when you knock
May you never eat alone
May you always find your way back to this block
And when I can't be there, and I won't always be
May the One who walks with me walk with you

[Verse 2: female voice]
He walked dusty roads with no place to sleep
Knew every town by the blisters on his feet
He blessed the children when they pushed them away
I'm asking him to do the same today

[Chorus: both voices, choir enters softly]
May his light find your window
May his peace be the roof on your home
May he keep you when I can't
May he hold you when you're grown
And whoever calls you Mama, and whoever calls them that
May the One who walks with me walk with them

[Bridge: choir building, handclaps, repeating]
Go with God (go with God)
Go in peace (go in peace)
Go on now (go on now)
Jesus has you, and he's got me

[Final Chorus: full choir, both leads above]
May his light find your window
May his peace be the roof on your home
May he keep you when I can't
May he hold you when you're grown
And whoever calls you Mama, and whoever calls them that
May the One who walks with me walk with them

[Outro: piano, a car door, spoken]
Call when you get there.
I will.
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 70 BPM, 4/4, B-flat major. Slow and steady, growing from a piano in a quiet room to a full choir.

VOICE: A man sings verse 1 plainly, like a father giving a toast he has not rehearsed. A woman with a clear, warm voice joins the chorus and takes verse 2. A choir comes in under the second chorus and carries the bridge. Two spoken lines at the end, parent and child.

INSTRUMENTS: Piano, a soft pad, acoustic guitar, a cello, bass, drums entering gently at the second chorus and opening up in the bridge, a gospel choir, handclaps in the bridge.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro piano. 0:12 Verse 1, him. 0:40 Chorus 1, both. 1:18 Verse 2, her. 1:46 Chorus 2, choir in. 2:22 Bridge, choir building. 2:50 Final chorus. 3:26 Outro, piano, a car door and two spoken lines, ends 3:42.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Live and warm, like a recording made in a church hall: piano close, choir all around, natural reverb.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'And whoever calls you Mama, and whoever calls them that' at 2:10.

THE REVEAL: Verse 1 and the first chorus are a parent's wishes; only the last line hints at a companion. Verse 2 at 1:18 describes him by the roads he walked, and the second chorus becomes a prayer to him. The bridge says the name.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Tongue-tied, giving, entrusting, letting go.
